study type: Retrospective chart review and before-and-after intervention study
exposure: ACOG-defined risk factors for GDM (BMI >25 or >23 for Asians, history of GDM, history of macrosomia, hypertension, polycystic ovarian syndrome, HbA1c >5.7, cardiovascular disease, family history of diabetes)
outcome: Early gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) screening rates
cohort: The study included 314 patients with complete charts from all deliveries at Mount Sinai West in January 2020 for baseline data, and subsequently eligible patients for early GDM screening after the intervention.
finding: The implementation of an electronic medical record reminder nearly doubled early GDM screening rates among eligible patients, from 12% to 28%.
